title: Drenyra canonical audit ledger entry
description: One canonical NDJSON entry of the append-only audit ledger (design §6). The entry hash and chain linkage are computed by the TS ledger core; this schema owns the shape and vocabularies.

entryId.description: Global stable identity of the entry (uuid), distinct from the positional sequence

sequence.description: Position within the ledger; monotonic and unique per ledgerId, never a timestamp

previousEntryHash.description: SHA-256 of the prior entry; genesis uses the canonical empty-string SHA-256

receiptHash.description: SHA-256 of the backing receipt, or the canonical empty-string SHA-256 when no receipt backs the entry

signerKeyId.description: hash-only when unsigned, otherwise the signing key id

payload.description: Entry payload: the genesis manifest, the embedded receipt bundle for RECEIPT_RECORDED, or a typed payload per entry type
